title: Cloud descriptor
description: A cloud bootstrap descriptor, as installed in `<plugin-path>/clouds.d/<cloud>.toml` (by default `/usr/share/tedge/bootstrap.d/clouds.d/`, overridable per site in `<config-dir>/bootstrap.d/clouds.d/`). It declares which registration methods a cloud supports, what inputs they need, and which settings the cloud requires. Descriptors are metadata only: they power the `tedge bootstrap` wizard, upfront validation and `--describe` output, while registration is executed by the built-in methods or the `register.d` hooks. The files are written in TOML; this schema describes their data model. Unknown keys are rejected here, even though the loader ignores them, so that typos are reported rather than silently doing nothing.

cloud.description: The cloud name, as passed to `tedge bootstrap <cloud>`. Conventionally matches the file name.

type.description: The cloud this descriptor derives from (e.g. `type = "c8y"`): the instance is bootstrapped as a custom-named instance of that cloud, with the base cloud's registration semantics, and inherits the base descriptor's registration methods and URL spec unless it declares its own. Resolution is single-level: a base that is itself derived is not resolved further.

description.description: One-line description of the cloud, shown by the wizard and `--describe`.

register.description: The registration methods this cloud supports. The first method flagged `default = true`, or else the first listed, is used when `--register` is not given.

settings.description: Settings the cloud needs, beyond the URL. A setting declared `prompt = false` is applied without asking.

configValues.description: Config keys mapped to the values they are set to.

urlSpec.description: How the cloud URL is obtained: prompt text, default, or a value that is not asked for.

description.description: Prompt text shown by the wizard, e.g. "ThingsBoard server (host or host:port)".

default.description: Pre-filled value offered by the wizard, accepted with an empty answer.

choices.description: When set, the wizard offers these values as a pick-list.

prompt.description: Whether the wizard asks for the URL. With `prompt = false`, the `default` is used without asking, and non-interactive runs do not require `--url`. An explicit `--url` still overrides it. Requires a `default`.

registerMethod.description: One registration method, as selected by `tedge bootstrap --register <name>`.

name.description: The method name, passed to `--register` and to the `register.d` hooks.

description.description: One-line explanation shown by the wizard and `--describe`.

default.description: Whether this is the default method when `--register` is not given.

inputs.description: Inputs the method needs, passed to the register hooks via environment variables. Restating a built-in c8y method (`c8y-ca`, `self-signed`, `basic`, `basic-preregistered`) without inputs keeps the compiled-in ones.

set.description: Config values implied by choosing this method, applied during the configure step. Keys are relative to the cloud (e.g. `auth_method`). Explicit `--set` values override them.

methodInput.description: A value a registration method needs, provided by the environment, prompted for by the wizard, or defaulted.

env.description: The environment variable carrying the value.

description.description: One-line explanation shown by the wizard and `--describe`.

secret.description: Secret values are prompted without echo and never shown.

required.description: Optional inputs don't fail validation when unset.

default.description: Value used when the environment variable is not set, applied in both interactive and non-interactive runs.

choices.description: When set, the wizard offers these values as a pick-list.

setting.description: A config value the wizard asks for and applies during the configure step.

key.description: The config key, relative to the cloud (e.g. `transport.port`), unless `global` is set.

global.description: The key is a device-global tedge config key (e.g. `proxy.address`), not scoped to the cloud: the answer is applied without the cloud prefix, and lands in the tedge config even for custom mappers.

name.description: The human-readable question shown by the wizard (e.g. "Select the Cumulocity MQTT connection type"). When absent, the wizard shows the key and description instead.

description.description: One-line explanation shown alongside the question.

required.description: Whether a value must be given for this setting.

default.description: Pre-filled value offered by the wizard, accepted with an empty answer. With choices, this selects the pre-selected choice by its *value*. Wizard-only unless `prompt = false`: shipped configuration defaults belong in the mapper's own `mapper.toml`, not in the descriptor.

prompt.description: Whether the wizard asks for this setting. With `prompt = false`, the `default` is applied without asking, in interactive and non-interactive runs alike - the way a cloud pins a config value. Method-level and choice-level `set` values and explicit `--set` values override it. Requires a `default`.

choices.description: When set, the wizard offers these values as a pick-list.

settingChoice.description: One selectable answer of a setting's pick-list: either a bare value displayed as-is, or a labeled table presenting the value in product vocabulary and optionally implying further config values.

oneOf.description: A labeled choice: the wizard shows the label and description, while the `value` is what lands in the setting's key.

value.description: The value stored in the setting's key when chosen.

label.description: The display label, defaulting to the value.

description.description: One-line explanation shown alongside the label.

set.description: Further config values implied by this choice, with keys relative to the cloud like the setting's own key. Explicit `--set` values override them.
